how: Evaluate each calc against the LOCAL custom functions and compare the result to expect as text. A file running stale definitions fails regardless of the version it claims.
note: HexToRGB returns a multi-key object, and key ORDER in a JSON object is not a promise worth testing. Its vectors read one key at a time with JSONGetElement rather than asserting whole-object text.

vectors.asserts: RGBToHex returns six bare uppercase digits, no leading hash
PAD GUARD — a channel under 16 keeps both digits. Fails if the high nibble was dropped instead of written as 0.
black is six zeros, not an empty string
the top of the range is reachable
out-of-range channels clamp rather than wrapping or erroring
a fractional channel rounds, it does not truncate
HexToRGB accepts a bare string and reads the last channel correctly
three-digit shorthand expands by doubling each digit
FAIL-LOUD GUARD — a non-hex string is refused, never silently filtered down to something parseable
ROUND TRIP — the two functions are inverses across a value that is not a round number
